definition: Hypertrophy is an excessive enlargement of an organ caused by growth of its tissue elements. In historical usage, it may also be used more broadly for abnormal overgrowth, though some writers distinguished this from hyperplasia by reserving hypertrophy for increased cell size and hyperplasia for increased cell number.
